profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | DevOps | AWS Certified
profile.summary:
I’m a Senior Software Engineer focused on backend infrastructure, platform architecture, and production reliability. At Office Puzzle, I lead platform and deployment modernization for a SaaS product, including the migration from AWS Elastic Beanstalk to Amazon EKS across a multi-account AWS environment.

My work combines backend engineering, Terraform, Kubernetes, Helm, Jenkins, Vault observability, and AWS integrations to make systems faster to deploy, easier to operate, and more cost efficient. Recent impact includes reducing compute costs by 50%, lowering overall infrastructure spend by 35-40%, and cutting deployment time from about 45 minutes to around 5 minutes.

Before Office Puzzle, I worked at Amdocs/Vindicia on subscription billing and payment platforms, helping modernize legacy Perl workflows into Python services using Flask, FastAPI, AWS Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3, MSK, and Terraform-backed infrastructure. I also contributed to machine-learning-backed fraud and revenue recovery workflows.

Earlier at DT One, I built backend and portal systems for global digital rewards platforms using Python, Perl, PHP, PostgreSQL, Vue.js, and related technologies.

I enjoy working at the intersection of backend engineering, cloud infrastructure, deployments, API optimization, and cost-aware architecture.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Leading the migration of the Office Puzzle SaaS platform from AWS Elastic Beanstalk to Amazon EKS across a multi-account AWS organization, reducing compute costs by 50% and overall infrastructure spend by 35-40%.
- Architected layered Terraform infrastructure using reusable modules, S3 remote state, DynamoDB locking, and cross-layer dependencies for bootstrap, networking, user management, EKS, DNS, Jenkins, and messaging.
- Built Jenkins CI/CD from scratch with Configuration as Code, shared Job DSL pipelines, Kubernetes build agents, and Helm-based deployments, reducing deployment time from about 45 minutes to around 5 minutes.
- Implemented Helm-driven deployments across development, beta, staging, and production with rolling updates, HPA policies, PodDisruptionBudgets, and autoscaling Kubernetes node groups.
- Drive major backend changes requiring AWS integrations across services such as S3, SES, SQS, SNS, Route53, ECR, and application workloads.
- Optimize API, PDF processing, and platform workloads for reliability, performance, observability, and operating cost.
- Built production observability and reliability tooling with Prometheus, Grafana, ServiceMonitors, custom metrics, and alerting for API and PDF processing workloads.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
As a Software Developer at Amdocs, I contribute to the development and optimization of large-scale enterprise solutions, ensuring system reliability, scalability, and performance. My role involves maintaining and modernizing legacy systems while spearheading the transition to a scalable, cloud-native microservices architecture.

Legacy System Optimization: Ensure the stability and performance of core platforms, built in Perl and hosted on AWS, utilizing DynamoDB, PostgreSQL, MSK, and S3.

Cloud & Microservices Development: Design and implement microservices using AWS Lambda, API Gateway, and Flask, enhancing efficiency and scalability across various enterprise solutions.

Machine Learning Integration: Collaborate with data science teams to integrate AI-driven fraud detection and revenue recovery solutions, leveraging vast transaction datasets.

DevOps & Continuous Deployment: Automate deployments and CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, Docker, and Terraform, optimizing software delivery and infrastructure management.

Agile & Cross-functional Collaboration: Work within Agile teams, utilizing Jira for sprint planning and execution, ensuring seamless collaboration with product, QA, and operations teams.

My focus is on driving innovation, optimizing cloud-based solutions, and ensuring Amdocs continues to deliver cutting-edge enterprise software solutions.

positions.description:
• Developer of https://check-app.dtone.com portal
• Resolves complex customer problems via phone, emails and remote access for TransferTo products and their integration into enterprise-wide mixed environments
• Provides resolutions to customer issues or qualifies the customer issue for senior level assistance or other vendor assistance.

• Provides guidance to new customer and their integration with TransferTo products

• Script development and platform enhancement.
